description: The Rothco Camper's Survivor Mirror is a must-have tool for any outdoor adventure. Constructed from high-quality stainless steel, this 3'' x 4'' mirror is both durable and rust-resistant, ensuring it stands up to the elements. Its double-faced design provides versatility, serving as both a signaling device in emergencies and a handy mirror for personal grooming. Compact and lightweight, it's easy to carry and store, making it an essential addition to any camper's, hiker's, or survivalist's gear.
